name: Curve Structure vs Next-Quarter Roll Yield
description: Does backwardation/contango predict next-quarter roll yield in corn and soybeans? Measures roll yield as the difference between BackwardRatio-adjusted and unadjusted 63-day forward returns. Signal is carry sign (positive = backwardation). Outputs: carry vs roll yield scatter, regime comparison bars, and stats table with N/median/hit rate.
source:
# Curve Structure vs Next-Quarter Roll Yield
# Does backwardation/contango predict the next quarter's roll yield?
# Roll yield = BackwardRatio return - NoAdjustment return (isolates roll component)
# Signal = cont.carry sign (positive = backwardation, negative = contango)

# --- Data: Two continuations with different adjustments ---
src = market_data_source()()

# BackwardRatio: returns embed roll yield
cont_adj = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# NoAdjustment: pure spot price returns (no roll yield)
cont_raw = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Signal: Carry from raw continuation ---
carry = cont_raw.carry
close_raw = cont_raw.c

# --- Roll Yield Isolation ---
# Forward 63-day returns on adjusted (includes roll) vs unadjusted (spot only)
fwd_ret_adj = forward_returns(period=63)(cont_adj.c)
fwd_ret_raw = forward_returns(period=63)(cont_raw.c)

# Roll yield = total return - spot return
roll_yield_63d = fwd_ret_adj - fwd_ret_raw

# --- Regime Classification ---
regime = conditional_select(
    is_valid(carry) and carry > 0, "Backwardation",
    is_valid(carry) and carry < 0, "Contango",
    "Neutral"
)

# Hit rate: positive roll yield in each regime
is_backwardation = is_valid(carry) and carry > 0
is_contango = is_valid(carry) and carry < 0

# Roll yield filtered by regime (for bar chart aggregation)
ry_backwardation = where(is_backwardation, roll_yield_63d)
ry_contango = where(is_contango, roll_yield_63d)

# Hit rate series: 1 if positive roll yield, 0 if negative, NaN if no data
hit_back = where(is_backwardation and is_valid(roll_yield_63d), 1.0 if roll_yield_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_cont = where(is_contango and is_valid(roll_yield_63d), 1.0 if roll_yield_63d > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Regime Flip Detection for Event Markers ---
carry_crosses_up = crossover(carry, 0)
carry_crosses_down = crossunder()(carry, 0)
is_regime_flip = carry_crosses_up or carry_crosses_down

# --- Timestamp for charts ---
ts = index().value

# --- Output 1: Scatter — Carry Level vs Next-Quarter Roll Yield ---
# Answers: Is the relationship monotonic? Does deeper backwardation = more roll yield?
xy_scatter(
    title="Does Deeper Backwardation Mean More Roll Yield?",
    x_axis_label="Carry (Front - Back, $/unit)",
    y_axis_label="Next-Quarter Roll Yield (%)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category="Term Structure & Roll Yield",
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero Carry"),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero Roll Yield", vertical=False)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=carry, y_values=(roll_yield_63d,))

# --- Output 2: Regime Bars — Avg Roll Yield by Regime ---
# Answers: Punchline — backwardation earns positive roll yield, contango doesn't?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title="Median Next-Quarter Roll Yield by Regime",
    y_axis_label="Median 63-Day Roll Yield",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category="Term Structure & Roll Yield",
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Backwardation", color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Contango", color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(ry_backwardation, ry_contango))

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — N, Median, Hit Rate per Regime ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Roll Yield Stats by Curve Regime",
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=["Daily Obs (N)", "Median Roll Yield", "Hit Rate (% Positive)", "Best Roll Yield", "Worst Roll Yield"],
        col_headers=["Backwardation", "Contango"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Term Structure & Roll Yield",
    order=3
)(ry_backwardation, ry_contango, ry_backwardation, ry_contango, hit_back, hit_cont, ry_backwardation, ry_contango, ry_backwardation, ry_contango)

# --- Event Markers: Regime Flips ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Curve Regime Flip",
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="New Regime", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Carry ($/unit)", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Front Price", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime, carry, close_raw, is_regime_flip)
